alloy.preparation: Specimens polished to 3/0 emery paper, pickled in 2 N NaOH at 80 °C for 5 min, then washed in distilled water. Most electrodes 1.5 cm long × 0.4 cm diameter, mounted to a nickel wire against a glass tube with watertight Teflon gasket; only electrode, Teflon and glass contacted the electrolyte.

test_solution.preparation: Deaerated before measurements by purified N2 previously passed over Cu turnings at 400 °C; all-glass cell in an air thermostat (25 ± 0.2 °C for usual tests); water–ice bath at 0 °C.

test_method.procedure_description: First polarized anodically within the passive region for 5 min at −0.80 V vs SCE (−0.56 V SHE), then advanced by 50 mV every 5 min while current was noted. Long-time runs held a selected potential near the critical value for at least 12 h; low-power microscopic observation used to determine steady-state Vc. Potentials reported vs SHE.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Non-steady-state Vc-prime: current rises sharply by two or more orders of magnitude. Steady-state Vc: least noble potential at which pits could not be observed after a long fixed-potential run.
